[[File:Chuck_Kallenbach.png|thumb|right|260px|Chuck Kallenbach. Still from the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00zEbUKIGRQ BoardMatt interview], 28 January 2024.]]
'''Chuck Kallenbach''' was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] (Gold 2) who became a full-time game designer in 1997. He playtested Premiere-era ''Star Wars'' CCG, then designed cards through the later printed sets, and went on to Decipher's ''Young Jedi'', ''Jedi Knights'', and ''The Lord of the Rings'' TCG. Printed SWCCG titles hide his family name, his wife's name, and his dog Raven as anagrams.<ref name="tor-lotr1">[https://www.theonering.net/torwp/2002/05/17/26593-decipher-talks-lotr-part-1-chuck-kallenbach/ Decipher Talks LOTR Part 1: Chuck Kallenbach], TheOneRing.net, 17 May 2002</ref><ref name="pc-sm">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/decipher-swccg-squadron-members/ Decipher SWCCG Squadron Members], starwarsccg.org (Gold 2, Overland, Mo)</ref><ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians]</ref>

The [[Players Committee]] Star Wars CCG Facebook page announced on 1 October 2024 that he had passed away.<ref name="fb-death">[https://www.facebook.com/starwarsccg/posts/chuck-kallenbach-former-designer-of-star-wars-ccg-has-passed-awaychuck-was-a-des/885436517128015/ Star Wars CCG], Facebook, 1 October 2024; archive [https://archive.ph/jbfZk archive.ph/jbfZk]</ref>

== Squadron Member ==

He was [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] '''Gold 2''', of Overland, Missouri.<ref name="pc-sm" /><ref name="sm">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas</ref> Gold 2 is the first numbered slot under Gold Leader [[Kendrick Summers]] at Decipher Inc.

== Playtester, then designer ==

Kallenbach was on the Genie Decipher boards as a ''Star Trek'' CCG playtester. [[Sandy Wible]] won the internet-representative job over him, then asked him to playtest SWCCG.<ref name="tfn">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/flashback/article.asp TheForce.Net Flashback Premiere &mdash; Chuck Kallenbach] (Red 84 / [[Josh Radke]])</ref> At the first Virginia playtest, unopposed battles were dropped in favor of [[Force drain]]. He went 9–1 with a Star Destroyer deck that day and picked up the nickname "Devastator Chuck." He suggested the title [[Gravel Storm]]; the hidden-image easter egg was added in-house.<ref name="tfn" />

After playtesting the premiere ''Star Trek'' and ''Star Wars'' CCGs, he joined Decipher full-time in 1997. He then helped develop ''Young Jedi'', ''Jedi Knights'', and the ''Lord of the Rings'' TCG, including LOTR rules editing.<ref name="tor-lotr1" /><ref name="tor-chat">[http://archives.theonering.net/events/logs/201001.html TheOneRing Chat &mdash; Tom Lischke and Chuck Kallenbach], 20 October 2001</ref> When he joined, [[Cloud City]] was already designed, and he playtested that set. He then worked with [[Jerry Darcy]] on [[Jabba's Palace]] alien-race mechanics. He said every card needed an image — [[Rollie Tesh]]'s question was "what's the image" — and that later sets used CGI (he names a Dreadnaught). He describes an Endor versus [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] split, a three-sets-a-year cadence, fly-in playtests, and [[Tom Lischke]] coming from playtester and number-one player into design. He calls the work top-down design.<ref name="may4">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SuiSGxtUuaY May The 4th Be With Chuck], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (3 May 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-SuiSGxtUuaY Internet Archive].</ref> The same Chuck footage is reused at the end of Baity's ''2025 SWCCG Worlds Special''.<ref name="worlds-special">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BuZYhkg35qo 2025 SWCCG Worlds Special], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (14 June 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-BuZYhkg35qo Internet Archive].</ref>

He wrote a 28 February 2007 account of the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] at the Cavalier Hotel, the Operative Worlds.<ref name="ck-worst">[https://iquotemyself.wordpress.com/2007/02/28/it-was-the-worst-of-times-period/ It was the Worst of Times. Period.], Chuck Kallenbach, i quote myself (28 February 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210719164120/https://iquotemyself.wordpress.com/2007/02/28/it-was-the-worst-of-times-period/ Internet Archive].</ref> He retold the mailed boxes and hall search on Booster Pack #07 and in the 2024 BoardMatt interview.<ref name="booster07" /><ref name="boardmatt">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00zEbUKIGRQ&t=3820s Interview with Game Designer Chuck Kallenbach], BoardMatt (28 January 2024), 1:03:40–1:05:20. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-00zEbUKIGRQ Internet Archive]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20260227005313/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00zEbUKIGRQ watch-page snapshot] (Wayback 27 February 2026).</ref> [[Radio Free Decipher]] placed him with Darcy and [[Tom Lischke]] from Broadcast 2 (11 December 1998) onward, later on Young Jedi, Jedi Knights, and LOTR episodes. Decipher WARS Radio billed him as WARS Brand Manager.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki</ref>

== After SWCCG ==

He presented a LOTR design seminar at [[DecipherCon 2002]] with [[Tim Ellington]].<ref name="ms21">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021221202659/http://decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/photos/pages/ms21.html Designers Tim Ellington and Chuck Kallenbach], DecipherCon 2002 photo gallery. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021221202659/http://decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/photos/pictures/ms21.jpg Internet Archive]</ref>

Later interviews cover ''Star Trek'' CCG, Young Jedi, Jedi Knights, LOTR TCG (InQuest / Origins awards for that game), WARS, ''.hack//ENEMY'', Sony's ''Star Wars Galaxies'' TCG, and other titles. The Booster Pack series (2021) called him a designer of thousands of cards across more than two dozen collectible games and used the "Devastator Chuck" playtest nickname.<ref name="booster07">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BvVRth2CIwQ THE BOOSTER PACK #07 &mdash; Chuck Kallenbach PART 1]</ref><ref name="booster08">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1uupsqSIY9U THE BOOSTER PACK #08 &mdash; Chuck Kallenbach PART 2]</ref>

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Kallenbach did additional design on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001) and worked on the game from its first day.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>
